cases.input: Fictional task: Prepare a 45-minute interview kit for an Accounts Payable Specialist. Approved requirements: accurate invoice matching, timely exception escalation, clear vendor communication, spreadsheet proficiency. Panel: Finance Lead and Operations Coordinator. Keep same core questions for every candidate. Include a distinct not-assessed state.

criteria: Maps the four approved requirements to observable interview competencies without adding unsupported criteria.
Produces a 45-minute agenda with interviewer assignments and candidate close time.
Provides job-linked behavioral/situational questions and neutral probes.
Defines a behaviorally anchored 1–4 scorecard and separate not-assessed state; no automatic hiring decision.
